programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: The people of the besieged city of Oxford are in a desperate situation. Devastated by the King's brutal betrayal, Angelica has been cast out of court, and finds herself destitute and starving. Meanwhile, divisions are beginning to split the Parliamentarians.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Mystery Woman - At First Sight
programme.desc: After dating hot doctor Ben, "Mystery Woman" Samantha becomes curious about her family medical history so she sets out upstate to fictitious small town; Whiptail, California in search of her birth mother. Samantha finds her unfortunately she has just been arrested as a suspect in a murder. Murder and mystery follow Samantha wherever she goes.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.title: Mayflower Madam
programme.desc: Inspired by the explosive sex-for-sale scandal that rocked Manhattan in 1984, the infamous Sydney Biddle Barrows, a driven young socialite, opens an exclusive escort service catering to the wealthy and affluent. From Sydney's rise to become a million-dollar, modern-day madam to her notorious plummet into bankruptcy and public disgrace, experience a private glimpse into the forbidden world of high-class prostitution-where money talks...pleasure sells...and discretion is everything.

programme.title: Silent Night
programme.desc: Ho-ho-horror starring Malcolm McDowell (A Clockwork Orange). A vicious killer dressed as Santa Claus hides in plain sight during a small town's annual Christmas festivities.

programme.title: For Love Alone: The Ivana Trump Story
programme.desc: The triumphs and tragedies of Katrinka Kovár, a young Czechoslovakian ski prodigy who discovers high-society splendor in the arms of a wealthy American businessman. When lust turns to lies, Katrinka--long haunted by a burning secret from her past--sets out to find the love she left behind.

programme.title: Picking Up And Dropping Off
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Scott Wolf and Amanda Detmer. Two thirty-ish New Yorkers keep bumping into each other but lack the courage to become better acquainted.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: The Five People You Meet In Heaven
programme.desc: Social. American social drama, produced in 2004. An accident sends Eddie in Heaven! While there, he meets five people who explain to him what the key moments in his life were, through which the real meaning of his life is recorded.

programme.title: Arthur Hailey's: Detective
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Malcolm Ainslie, a Catholic priest turned distinguished investigator for the police, has agreed to hear the confession of a convicted serial killer sentenced to death in a just a matter of hours. What he promises to reveal to Ainslie is the truth behind the crimes and the reason he confessed to the one crime Ainslie doesn't even believe he committed. What unfolds between the two men is a serpentine trail into both men's pasts based on the bestseller from master storyteller Arthur Hailey.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In the near future, a virus of epic proportions has overtaken the planet. There are more Infected than Uninfected, and humanity is losing its grip on survival. Its only hope is finding a cure. After the fall of New York, Lauren - a doctor - has come to Los Angeles to lead the charge in the hunt for Uninfected survivors, and rescue her family barricaded in their LA home. Lauren's objective is simple: lead her team into the field and rescue survivors, filming their experiences so it can be used for research. But nothing could have prepared them for the mayhem they walk into. As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 9: Oh Baby
programme.desc: Murder mystery. A couple implicated in a murder go on the run, leaving their baby in the care of amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey. Can she look after the baby and solve the case? Kellie MartinCasey SanderNina Siemazsko Vicki Davis.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 10: In the Shadows
programme.desc: While searching for a KGB double agent who was about to be exposed by another Russian spy-turned-successful author, mystery bookstore owner Samantha Kinsey and her secretive friend and store manager, Philby are thrust into the murderous world of international espionage.

programme.title: A Grandpa for Christmas
programme.desc: Sentimental comedy drama starring Ernest Borgnine and Tracy Nelson. An ageing entertainer, estranged from his family, is called upon to take care of his granddaughter. (2007).

programme.title: Meet The Santas
programme.desc: Steve Guttenberg stars in the comedy sequel to ʻSingle Santa Seeks Mrs Clausʼ. Shortly before he is due to take on his fatherʼs mantle, the son of Santa plans to wed on Christmas Eve. His fiancéeʼs prim-and-proper society mother disapproves of her choice of husband and insists on controlling every aspect of the wedding. Can Nick Claus win over his in-laws and ensure that the ceremony goes smoothly?

programme.title: The Pledge/A Gunfighter's Pledge
programme.desc: Ex-lawman Matt Austin (Luke Perry) accidentally kills an innocent man (Alex Paez) while hunting an outlaw who killed his family. He pledges to the dying man that he will take his body to his sister Amaya (Jaclyn DeSantis). Austin wrestles with the idea of telling her he caused the death, but is faced with bigger battles once at the farm. There he gets involved with land baron Horn (C. Thomas Howell), who is trying to take Amaya's land. Their lives are more intertwined than he thought, when he takes on Horn and discovers that Horn has hired the man he was looking for all along.

programme.title: Desolation Canyon
programme.desc: Western about a sheriff ('Dallas' star, Patrick Duffy) who persuades his old friend (Stacy Keach, 'Prison Break'), a retired gunslinger, to join himin pursuit of a notorious gang. The band of outlaws counts the gunslinger's son as one of its members.

programme.title: Sacricfies of the Heart
programme.desc: Emotional family drama. A hotshot city lawyer (Melissa Gilbert, ʻLittle House on the Prairieʼ) returns to the family farm run by her older brother and her estranged father, who is suffering from Alzheimerʼs disease. As his health and memory deteriorate, she reaches a new understanding about what drove her mother to commit suicide.

programme.title: I Do (But I Don't)
programme.desc: Denise Richards plays Lauren, a divorced wedding-planner who falls for the groom-to-be (Dean Cain).

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Fulfilling his beloved wife's dying wish, William Campbell restores an abandoned building they own into a reading room for a depressed community notorious for its ineffectual high school and street gangs.

programme.title: Word of Honor
programme.desc: A corporate exec and family man is accused of participating in a war crime 30 years earlier during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.desc: In 1812, young British aristocrat Edmund Talbot travels by ship to Australia and learns more about himself and about life than he had ever bargained for.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: Mary Bryant, a Cornish girl who was convicted of petty theft, is being transported to the Australian Penal Colony on the First Fleet with other prisoners bound for Botany Bay.

programme.desc: Nick's plan to let fate bring his wife to him must be altered, because he must replace his father as Santa Claus on December 26. Ernst, the right-hand man to several generations of Santas, generates a list of potential mates. Nick dutifully sets off to meet them, but fate may have a candidate after all.

programme.title: Love is a Four Letter Word
programme.desc: Margaret and Martin Harper, both sixty years old, are filing for divorce, but plan to keep everything as civilized as possible. Complications arise when their respective attorneys, the equally cynical Emily Bennett and Kenton Rhodes, unexpectedly fall in love, throwing an extra kink into the proceedings both in and out of the courtroom.

programme.title: An Unexpected Love
programme.desc: An unhappily married housewife and mother of two children (Leslie Hope) seperates from her husband and gets a new job where she developes a mutual attraction to her female boss (Wendy Crewson).

programme.title: Mom at Sixteen
programme.desc: Jacey Jeffries (Danielle Panabaker) is a 16-year-old high school student and the mother of a baby boy named Charlie. Instead of giving him up for adoption as planned, she chose to keep the baby. Her mother, Terry (Mercedes Ruehl) pretends the infant is hers to allow Jacey to finish high school and lead a relatively normal life and graduate.

programme.title: Lone Rider
programme.desc: Bobby Hattaway (Lou Diamond Phillips), an honored soldier, returns home after the American Civil War to find his father's (Stacy Keach) formerly prosperous store now dangerously in debt to the town's ruthless leader, and Bobby's childhood friend, Stu Croker (Vincent Spano). Bobby will now face off against his former friend to take control from Stu.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: During the heat of battle in the midst of the Civil War, a beguilingly innocent colt is born to Union Jim Rabb's beloved mare. Refusing the orders to shoot it, lest it prove a hindrance, Rabb keeps the colt as a consolation in these desperate times-a symbol of hope that leads the men of the First Cavalry on a journey of self-discovery and newfound brotherhood.

programme.title: Andalūzijos turas. La Roda de Andalucia - Lucena (167,6 km)
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track trail. Riders choose their risks to secure an advantage, all the time fully conscious that one mistake navigating the rocky trails means their race is over. Winning this 9th edition of the Andalucia Bike Race, were Spain's David Valero in the men's elite, with Hildegunn Hovdenak of Norway tacking victory in the women's elite.

programme.title: Andalūzijos turas. La Roda de Andalucia - Lucena (167,6 km)
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track trail. Riders choose their risks to secure an advantage, all the time fully conscious that one mistake navigating the rocky trails means their race is over. Winning this 9th edition of the Andalucia Bike Race, were Spain's David Valero in the men's elite, with Hildegunn Hovdenak of Norway tacking victory in the women's elite.

We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a land of extremes. Many hundred thousand square miles of forests, grasslands and mountains. Existing here is a daunting proposition, and some well-known animals have adapted by growing large or very small, each strategy maximizing their chance of survival.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Whether right whales, penguins or sea lions - for the birth of their young, many marine creatures are drawn to Argentina's nearly 5,000 kilometer coastline. From their very first breath, it's all about one thing for the little ones: survival. Orcas hunt for young sea lions with a special technique and seagulls fly merciless aerial attacks on baby whales. Extraordinary underwater images and impressive animal behavior make the film by Christian Baumeister a visual experience.

programme.title: Wild Transylvania: Dracula's Hidden Kingdom
programme.desc: Dracula's Transylvania lair is brimming with amazing wildlife. Shielded by the Carpathian Mountains, it's a pristine wonderland that remains unchanged since the Middle Ages. Home to 26 species of bats, his kingdom is truly a night flyer's paradise. Chamois, cuckoos, Ural owls, wild boar, lynx, brown bears, and huge wolf packs also thrive in a natural world beyond Bram Stoker's imagination.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom: Clash of Clans Compilations
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Brand new series. Savute, Botswana: 2000 square miles of remote African savannah. This ancient land is governed by competing clans of ruthlessly proficient predators - leopards, lions, hyenas and wild dogs. Their survival depends on the giant herds of powerful prey - buffalo, elephant and zebra - who have roamed Savute in search of sustenance, season after season, millennium after millennium. Each day is a life-or-death struggle - animal against animal, animal against nature. There is no mercy, and there is but one rule: survive. In this episode, a small family of wild dogs goes on the run, desperately looking for a safe place to raise six tiny puppies. But the Savage Kingdom will test them to the limit. Narrated by Charles Dance.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

Once a great pride, their sons have been banished, and if they can't rebuild their pride they face hunger, exile or worse. Narrated by Charles Dance.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Savute is a land where natural law is taken to its limit and sometimes... beyond. Across six episodes we see the full impact that the cycle of Savute's seasons has on every carnivore clan. The rains leave a time of birth and plenty in their wake, but all too soon the soil is parched and the grass gone. Rival tribes of predators are squeezed into a cauldron of competition. This season in Savute, who will survive?

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Brand new series. Savute, Botswana: 2000 square miles of remote African savannah. This ancient land is governed by competing clans of ruthlessly proficient predators - leopards, lions, hyenas and wild dogs. Their survival depends on the giant herds of powerful prey - buffalo, elephant and zebra - who have roamed Savute in search of sustenance, season after season, millennium after millennium. Each day is a life-or-death struggle - animal against animal, animal against nature. There is no mercy, and there is but one rule: survive. In this episode, a small family of wild dogs goes on the run, desperately looking for a safe place to raise six tiny puppies. But the Savage Kingdom will test them to the limit. Narrated by Charles Dance.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom

This ancient land is governed by competing clans of ruthlessly proficient predators - leopards, lions, hyenas and wild dogs. Each day is a life-or-death struggle - animal against animal, animal against nature. There is no mercy, and there is but one rule: survive. Not all lions in the Savage Kingdom are born equal. While the marsh pride dominates the beating heart of the realm, the three lionesses of the northern pride struggle to hold their ground in the forests and hills. Once a great pride, their sons have been banished, and if they can't rebuild their pride they face hunger, exile or worse. Narrated by Charles Dance.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Step inside the most frigid habitat known to Earth - the poles. Here, the planet's ultimate survivalists include whale-hunting polar bears, leopard-seal dodging penguins and a pack of Arctic wolves that bring down a pair of musk oxen. Polar species have evolved bodies and behaviours that help them combat the intense hostility of their habitats. But now, their world is changing so fast - literally breaking apart under their feet - and their resilience will be tested beyond the extreme.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: Polar Worlds with Bertie Gregory Mashup
programme.desc: The North and South poles - one force determines everything for the animals who call these regions home: water. Wildlife filmmaker Bertie Gregory travels towards both extremes of the Earth to find the creatures who have mastered surviving in the icy waters of some of the planet's harshest landscapes.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When Cosmo and Wanda grant a wish to make Hazel's potato project work for the Science Fair, they rewrite the rules of science for the whole universe! When the physical world goes haywire as a result, they can't undo it because not even their magic is not working correctly! And Sci, the Science Fairy, refuses to help Hazel because he does not approve of her shortcut. Hazel must learn the real science behind her potato project to power up Cosmo and Wanda's wands and set the universe right again. // After watching a detective TV show with her dad, Hazel wishes she could solve a mystery like a genuine gumshoe. At first, she is wrapped up in the thrill of solving a mystery, but things get real when the landlord goes missing. Everyone is a suspect - kids at school, the strange new neighbors, and even Cosmo and Wanda! Things intensify when Hazel suspects her family is the next target. In a dramatic climax at dinner at her neighbors', Hazel unveils the truth. Is it foul play? Or is it just her imagination?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel's feelings are hurt when her friends decide to go to the school dance instead of her book club. She storms off, but then realizes she wants to go to the dance too. Hazel wishes for Kennueth, a half-fish, half-man character from her favorite manga, to come out of his story and take her to the dance. Hazel must get through the dance before Kennueth's true form, and magic, are revealed. // Hazel learns about the harmful effects of trash and pollution on Earth, so she wishes that people wouldn't be such trash monsters. Cosmo and Wanda summon a friendly, talking, trash eating dumpster named Danky! Together they spread the word about sustainability and caring for the earth. Then, Dale Dimmadome tricks Danky into helping him sell more products, making people even bigger trash monsters! Hazel must get Danky back and stop Dale Dimmadome in his wasteful tracks.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Antics on Ice: Private's in heaven - icy, freezing heaven. The Lunacorns on Ice extravaganza is in town, and Skipper's determined to take him as a treat. Accompanied by unexpected fellow fanboys Bing and Roy, the gang heads to the arena. Things get a bit d-icey when the gorilla and rhino end up on the ice with the lunacorns. The enraged director is ready to shutter the whole thing unless they find some way to slip 'n slide out of it. Showdown on Fairway 18:A legendary putter is at the center of controversy when the Amarillo Kid returns to the zoo. The slippery armadillo needs Private's help to make good on an ill-advised bet with two gopher brothers. Who's the bad guy here though? The gophers show up at the zoo to actually warn the penguins about the kid! The story takes us on more twists and turns than a Pebble Beach golf hole!

Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.desc: Un insegnante di inglese disilluso si reca in Argentina nel 1976 per insegnare. Si trova di fronte a una classe di ragazzi turbolenti e a un Paese nel caos. Quando salva un pinguino da una spiaggia inquinata dal petrolio, tutto cambia.

programme.title: Quasi orfano
programme.desc: Commedia con Riccardo Scamarcio e Vittoria Puccini. Milano: un designer pugliese che ha rinnegato le sue origini viene travolto dagli equivoci quando la sua famiglia viene a trovarlo.

programme.title: Hunger Games
programme.desc: Jennifer Lawrence è la coraggiosa protagonista di un visionario action. In una società distopica, 24 ragazzi si giocano la vita in un reality show.

programme.title: I morti non soffrono
programme.desc: Negli anni 1860, la francocanadese vivace e indipendente Vivienne Le Coudy intraprende un viaggio con l'immigrato danese Holger Olsen, cercando di costruire una vita insieme nella polverosa città di Elk Flats, Nevada.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: Nell'ottavo capitolo della saga, Tom Cruise alias Agente Hunt corre contro il tempo per impedire allo spietato sistema di Intelligenza Artificiale chiamato Entita' di distruggere il pianeta.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: Speciale - Avvocato Ligas
programme.desc: Luca Argentero e il cast presentano l’Avvocato Ligas, penalista anticonvenzionale sempre pronto a rischiare pur di vincere una causa.

programme.title: The Life of Chuck
programme.desc: Dalla penna di Stephen King, un emozionante inno alla vita diretto da Mike Flanagan. La straordinaria vita dell'uomo comune Charles Krantz (Tom Hiddleston) raccontata a ritroso.

programme.title: Il professore e il pinguino
programme.desc: Un insegnante di inglese disilluso si reca in Argentina nel 1976 per insegnare. Si trova di fronte a una classe di ragazzi turbolenti e a un Paese nel caos. Quando salva un pinguino da una spiaggia inquinata dal petrolio, tutto cambia.

programme.title: Quo vado?
programme.desc: La commedia dei record di Checco Zalone che ironizza sul mito del posto fisso. Disposto a tutto per non esser licenziato, un impiegato statale vagherà da un capo all'altro del mondo.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell
programme.desc: Il manga di culto rivive in un live-action fantascientifico con Scarlett Johansson. Salvata da un incidente, una donna viene trasformata in un cyborg con il compito di fermare il crimine.

programme.title: Quasi orfano
programme.desc: Commedia con Riccardo Scamarcio e Vittoria Puccini. Milano: un designer pugliese che ha rinnegato le sue origini viene travolto dagli equivoci quando la sua famiglia viene a trovarlo.

programme.title: Enzo
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino in una lucida analisi sul bisogno di trovare un posto nel mondo. Enzo, 16 anni, decide di abbandonare la scuola e una vita agiata per diventare muratore.

programme.title: Robin Hood - L'origine della leggenda
programme.desc: Tornato in Inghilterra, Robin di Loxley scopre che il malvagio sceriffo di Nottingham ha preso possesso delle sue proprietà. L'uomo si unisce a una banda di ribelli, in un piano audace per rubare allo sceriffo i suoi soldi e togliergli il potere.

programme.title: Il bacio che aspettavo
programme.desc: Deluso da una donna e salvato dalle donne. Succede ad un aspirante scrittore che rompe con la fidanzata storica e si rifugia insieme al suo cuore infranto nel paese della nonna. Nuovi incontri gli faranno tornare la voglia di innamorarsi.

programme.title: Hometown - La strada dei ricordi
programme.desc: Un documentario biografico basato sui ricordi di due artisti famosi. Il regista Roman Polanski e il fotografo Ryszard Horowitz tornano insieme in Polonia dopo 60 anni, e tra le strade di Cracovia ripercorrono l'infanzia e la giovinezza segnate dalla Shoah.

programme.title: Malcolm X
programme.desc: Denzel Washington, vincitore a Berlino, interpreta l’attivista per i diritti degli afroamericani nel biopic di Spike Lee che ne racconta la storia dall’infanzia fino all’assassinio.

programme.title: Dream Horse
programme.desc: Toni Collette e Damian Lewis in un’emozionante storia vera. Galles: una cassiera convince i suoi concittadini a investire su un purosangue per partecipare a un prestigioso concorso ippico.

programme.title: Mon Crime - La colpevole sono io
programme.desc: François Ozon dirige una commedia a tinte gialle nella Parigi degli anni 30. Una giovane aspirante attrice viene accusata dell'omicidio di un famoso produttore. Nel cast Isabelle Huppert.

programme.title: Giurato numero 2
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: Il quinto potere
programme.desc: Il fenomeno WikiLeaks nel thriller biografico con Benedict Cumberbatch. La storia della piattaforma online e del suo fondatore Julian Assange che ha fatto tremare i governi del mondo.

programme.title: Il miglio verde
programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel dramma carcerario tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. 1935: un gigantesco uomo di colore, dotato di poteri curativi, viene condannato a morte per omicidio.

programme.title: Emilia Perez
programme.desc: 2 Oscar, Miglior attrice e Premio della giuria a Cannes per l'originale pellicola di Jacques Audiard con Zoe Saldana, Karla Sofia Gascon, Selena Gomez.

programme.title: A mano disarmata
programme.desc: Claudia Gerini nel biopic sulla giornalista Federica Angeli. La cronista de 'La Repubblica' indaga sulla criminalita' organizzata di Ostia. Le ritorsioni non tarderanno ad arrivare.

programme.title: Aprile
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta una commedia pungente che e' insieme opera autobiografica e resoconto critico delle vicende politiche, dalla primavera del 1994 all’estate del 1997.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: I paesaggi incontaminati dell'Alaska, le musiche di Eddie Vedder (Golden Globe per la miglior canzone originale, "Guaranteed') e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Dopo essersi laureato con il massimo dei voti, appena diciottenne, il giovane Christopher McCandless lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un lungo viaggio impervio e intimo a contatto con la natura. Solo, senza soldi o altre risorse, in un lungo cammino attraverso gli Stati Uniti, scandito da numerosi incontri, fino ad arrivare nella selvaggia Alaska.

programme.title: Il miglio verde
programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel dramma carcerario tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. 1935: un gigantesco uomo di colore, dotato di poteri curativi, viene condannato a morte per omicidio.

programme.title: Diamanti
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek firma il suo maggior successo con un maestoso cast al femminile. Un regista convoca le sue attrici preferite: vuole fare un film sulle donne ma non svela altro.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Il signore delle mosche
programme.desc: Un gruppo di ragazzi sopravvive a un incidente aereo e tenta di organizzarsi su un'isola tropicale. Tra loro c'è il giovane Piggy che, insieme a Raph, prova a radunare i dispersi.

programme.title: Il signore delle mosche
programme.desc: Nel gruppo di ragazzi affiorano le prime fratture e l'ambizioso Jack, rompendo con Ralph e promettendo divertimento e caccia, decide di formare una tribù autonoma separata.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: I paesaggi incontaminati dell'Alaska, le musiche di Eddie Vedder (Golden Globe per la miglior canzone originale, "Guaranteed') e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Dopo essersi laureato con il massimo dei voti, appena diciottenne, il giovane Christopher McCandless lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un lungo viaggio impervio e intimo a contatto con la natura. Solo, senza soldi o altre risorse, in un lungo cammino attraverso gli Stati Uniti, scandito da numerosi incontri, fino ad arrivare nella selvaggia Alaska.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: The Alto Knights - I due volti del crimine
programme.desc: Barry Levinson dirige Robert De Niro in un thriller dallo sceneggiatore di "Quei bravi ragazzi". New York, anni 50: per ottenere il controllo del mondo malavitoso, il boss Vito Genovese ordina di uccidere il rivale Frank Costello, che sopravvive miracolosamente all'attentato.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Michael Collins
programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: I paesaggi incontaminati dell'Alaska, le musiche di Eddie Vedder (Golden Globe per la miglior canzone originale, "Guaranteed') e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Dopo essersi laureato con il massimo dei voti, appena diciottenne, il giovane Christopher McCandless lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un lungo viaggio impervio e intimo a contatto con la natura. Solo, senza soldi o altre risorse, in un lungo cammino attraverso gli Stati Uniti, scandito da numerosi incontri, fino ad arrivare nella selvaggia Alaska.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al War Movie di Christopher Nolan che ripercorre la storica Operazione Dynamo. 1940: la difesa degli inglesi, attaccati dai nazisti, viene narrata da un triplice punto di vista.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: Pulp fiction
programme.desc: 1 Oscar, 1 Golden Globe e Palma d'oro a Cannes per il film-simbolo di Quentin Tarantino con John Travolta, Uma Thurman e Bruce Willis in un intreccio di scene cult e personaggi stravaganti.

programme.title: Nel nome del padre
programme.desc: Biopic con Daniel Day-Lewis ed Emma Thompson diretti da Jim Sheridan, Orso d'oro a Berlino. La drammatica vicenda giudiziaria di 4 irlandesi condannati ingiustamente per terrorismo.

programme.title: Il Padrino: Epilogo - La morte di Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia, restaurato e rimontato da Francis Ford Coppola. Il sessantenne Mike Corleone individua in Vincent il successore del suo impero criminale.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al War Movie di Christopher Nolan che ripercorre la storica Operazione Dynamo. 1940: la difesa degli inglesi, attaccati dai nazisti, viene narrata da un triplice punto di vista.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: 3 Oscar, 3 Golden Globe e Leone d'argento alla regia di Brady Corbet che dirige Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones e Guy Pearce. Un architetto ebreo e sua moglie, sopravvissuti all'Olocausto, lasciano l'Ungheria per emigrare negli Stati Uniti. Un facoltoso cliente cambierà le loro vite.

programme.title: Resistance
programme.desc: Jesse Eisenberg, Ed Harris e Clemence Poesy nel biopic su Marcel Marceau. Nella Francia occupata dai nazisti, il mimo si unisce alla Resistenza per salvare centinaia di bambini ebrei.

programme.title: Il grande Lebowski
programme.desc: Commedia cult del Fratelli Coen con Jeff Bridges, John Goodman e Steve Buscemi. Drugo, un ex hippie omonimo di un ricco magnate, deve risolvere il caso di un misterioso rapimento.

programme.title: Zero Dark Thirty
programme.desc: 1 Oscar per il thriller di Kathryn Bigelow con Joel Edgerton e Jessica Chastain, premiata ai Golden Globe. Un team della Cia collabora con i Navy Seals per catturare Osama Bin Laden.

programme.title: Margin Call
programme.desc: Kevin Spacey, Paul Bettany e Jeremy Irons in un thriller ambientato a Wall Street. All'alba della crisi finanziaria, un gruppo di manager ha 24 ore per evitare il fallimento di una banca.

programme.title: Il paziente inglese
programme.desc: 9 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe all’intenso dramma con Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche e Willem Dafoe. Toscana, 2a guerra mondiale: un'infermiera accudisce un uomo che nasconde un tragico segreto.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per Spike Lee e Oscar alla sceneggiatura. Un poliziotto afroamericano si infiltra nel Ku Klux Klan per indagare sul razzismo nell'America degli anni 70.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: Fuori
programme.desc: Valeria Golino, Elodie e Matilda De Angelis, premiate con il Nastro d'Argento, nel film di Mario Martone dal romanzo autobiografico di Goliarda Sapienza. 1980: in carcere, la scrittrice instaura un legame di sorellanza con due detenute che continua quando le donne ritrovano la libertà.

programme.title: The Young Messiah
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Anne Rice, una pellicola che ripercorre l'infanzia di Gesu'. A 7 anni il futuro Messia lascia l'Egitto per tornare a Nazareth dove scopre le sue vere origini.

programme.title: Bad Boys: Ride or Die
programme.desc: I due poliziotti di Miami, incastrati dalle mele marce del dipartimento, devono sfuggire dai colleghi e dai narcotrafficanti. Per risolvere la sporca faccenda agiranno per conto proprio e fuori dai limiti consentiti dalla legge.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Will Smith e Martin Lawrence in un action dal regista di "Transformers". Due poliziotti braccano una banda di narcotrafficanti. L'unica che puo' aiutarli e' una prostituta che viene rapita.

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: Will Smith e Martin Lawrence tornano in azione in un travolgente sequel diretto da Michael Bay. I due detective della Squadra Narcotici di Miami devono fermare un traffico di ecstasy.

programme.title: Bad Boys for Life
programme.desc: Azione e nostalgia nel terzo capitolo della saga con Will Smith e Martin Lawrence. I detective Lowrey e Burnett fanno di nuovo squadra per fermare la killer di un cartello messicano, evasa dal carcere con l’obiettivo di vendicarsi dei responsabili del suo arresto.

programme.desc: Lezione di suspense e paura per la regia di Alfred Hitchcock, con Anthony Perkins, Vera Miles e Janet Leigh. Una donna in fuga arriva nel tetro motel gestito dall'inquietante Norman Bates.

Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. programme.desc: Il cacciatore di vampiri Wesley Snipes, ispirato a un fumetto della Marvel Comics, torna in un secondo episodio sempre più ricco di d'azione e combattimenti. Questa volta dovrà vedersela con un terribile nemico, Jared Nomak, a capo di una nuova e più spietata razza di mutanti che fa strage di uomini e di vampiri per dominare il mondo. Solo la precaria alleanza proprio con i vampiri, che Blade ha sempre combattuto. potrà dare una speranza all'umanità. Fra discoteche e fogne, la caccia al mutante è aperta, ma Blade scoprirà una verità sconcertante.

Ora il suo mestiere e' valutare la sicurezza degli edifici, come l'avveniristico grattacielo 'The Pearl' in Cina. Quando un pauroso incendio avvolge l'edificio, Sawyer viene ritenuto ingiustamente responsabile dell'accaduto ed e' costretto a fuggire. Ma nel grattacielo ci sono sua moglie e i suoi bambini. Per salvarli dovra' sottostare al ricatto dei terroristi che chiedono in cambio qualcosa di molto prezioso all'interno del 'The Pearl'.

programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: When a mysterious creature keeps stealing people’s prized possessions, the crew discovers the Nine-Tailed Fox, a trickster rooted in Chinese lore. The crew eventually comes back together and realizes that NTF takes items people think they need to be happy. Yi was able to hold onto her violin because it truly does make her happy and is a fundamental part of who she is.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: While Everest is going through some typical teenager growing pains (not wanting to brush his teeth or tidy his room…), a welcome distraction comes in the form of LiLi, an adorable nine-year-old who’s positively obsessed with Yi, Everest, and the crew’s pursuits. When Everest doesn’t return from a sweets-filled outing with LiLi, the crew discovers LiLi’s intentions might not have been so pure.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Superstar-level mania sets in when the renowned and prosperity-brining creature Qilin appears in front of Yi’s building. programme.desc: The depleted team flies through space and enters a region of pure darkness, with no sign of life and seemingly no way out.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: An attempt to quell Liam's manic energy throws Birch into conflict. Does she continue helping her hyperactive cousin learn to relax or does she pull him into the school's Manga Slam? Will Liam become too relaxed or bring a never-before-seen energy to Cosmos High's stage?

programme.desc: After Birch watches a late night mockumentary on TV about aliens among us, she becomes a big ball of paranoia as she misinterprets her schoolmates' head twitches, hand gestures and overall comportment. programme.title: Beh Buti Nga ep 12
programme.desc: After making a fortune from Bitcoin, Axel gets back at the girls who once broke his heart. When he succeeds, he makes it a mission to help his high school barkada to become confident heartbreakers. However, things take a turn when Isabelle their only female friend in high school starts forming a bond with Axel and he falls in love with her for real.

programme.title: Kagat ng Dilim 2020 ep 11
programme.desc: REBOOT: Urban legends and urban horror stories set against a backdrop of modern-day events and headlines, terrifying tales told in mock-documentary style make up this groundbreaking original horror series.

programme.title: Hapi House Season 1 ep 1
programme.desc: A Sari-Sari Original Series. Ha-pi House is a home away from home for a group of single half-Pinoys and Pinoys born and raised overseas who have come home to rediscover their Filipino roots.

programme.title: Totoy Bato ep 212
programme.desc: The series is based on the graphic novel created by Carlo J. Caparas. Totoy Bato, a young man, fighting for justice for his lost loved ones; also fighting for equality and fairness against his old friend turned nemesis Dwayne.

programme.title: Cuerpo Y Alma ep 5
programme.desc: Maya, a young nurse who has been having terrifying nightmares finds out a horrifying truth about a debt that was made to save her life when she was a child. As she's about to find out, the payment just may cost her much more than her life.

programme.title: Body Of Lies
programme.desc: Trust no one. Deceive everyone. When idealistic CIA agent Roger Ferris (Di Caprio -- The Departed, Blood Diamond) is stationed in Jordan after being wounded in Iraq, he dedicates his life to stopping further attacks by Al Qaeda. Following a plan that the British employed successfully against the Nazis, Ferris plants the suspicion among the terrorists that their leaders are collaborating with the Americans. But as the stakes rise and Ferris finds himself in the crosshairs, the plot he starts spirals into an outcome he could never have foreseen.

programme.title: World's Dumbest S16 9
programme.desc: Let freedom ring, as World's Dumbest presents \"Only in America.\" Featuring 20 of the most patriotic patriots in the land - from a cop's strange take on the national anthem, to a dangerous mishap with a bald eagle, and the most insane thank you to thetroops ever put on film. Plus awesome commentary from our cast of America's best comics, including Brendon Walsh, Kevin McCaffrey and Jaime Andrews.

programme.title: World's Dumbest S16 10
programme.desc: The spotlight shines on 20 of the Worlds Dumbest Performers. Plus, awesome commentary from our cast of comedians, including Brendon Walsh, Kevin McCaffrey and Jaime Andrews.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set \"within the architecture of the mind.\" Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.title: Get Smart
programme.desc: Comic superstar Steve Carell takes on the role of Agent Maxwell Smart and Anne Hathaway steps into the shoes of sexy Agent 99 as the two superspies out to save the world from the nefarious forces of KAOS in this romp based on the classic television show created by Mel Brooks and Buck Henry.

programme.title: Smallville S2 5

programme.title: Smallville S2 6

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guillermo del Toro (Pan's Labyrinth) brings out the big guns in this sci-fi action epic about a ragtag band of humans that band together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea. Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, earth's survivors (including Charlie Hunnam, Charlie Day \u0026 Rinko Kikuchi) take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes -- a washed up former pilot and an untested trainee -- who now stand as earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc:
Behind every great love is a great story.

In Seabrook, South Carolina in the 1940s, teenaged debutante Allie Hamilton and local boy Noah Calhoun spend one passionate, carefree summer together and deeply in love. But when the summer ends, war and duty separate the young couple.

Today, an elderly man visits a nursing home to read from his notebook to a woman whose memory is fading. As he spins a tale of two young lovers with their whole lives before them, his beloved Allie relives a long-ago passion that has never died, an unbreakable bond between two ordinary people rendered extraordinary by the strength, power and beauty of true love.

Based on the novel by Nicholas Sparks, author of A Walk to Remember and Message in a Bottle.
